purpose: The pill CTA used ONLY inside the four pinned step slides, where it sits on a saturated gradient and therefore needs its own fixed colouring rather than the themed pair.

props.label: "Get started" on all four occurrences
props.hoverStagger: always true - all four are wrapped in [hover-stagger-wrap]

states.rest: fixed light pill on the slide gradient

notes: The -stb suffix also appears on .u-fonts-50-stb and the [data-flash-stb] motion hook: it marks the fixed-palette variants that live on the step gradients.
